absent: Numeric values and encodings for huge PMD and PUD sizes, masks, and base page counts.
Complete layouts of address space, virtual area, folio, table entry, gather, and notifier range types.
Implementations of table locks, folio locks, barriers, reference counting, and lock validation.
Translation flush, cache maintenance, and batched unmapping completion semantics.
Internals of folio splitting, collapse handling, migration waiting, deposited table transfer, and zero folio management.
Userfault modes, soft dirty support, NUMA balancing modes, swap and migration entry formats, and device private handling.
Reverse mapping walk, anon VMA locking, notifier delivery, and poison aware hugetlb unmapping details.
Broader callers and error handling for duplication, advice control, protection changes, moves, and area resizing.

findings.text: Provides duplication of a huge PUD mapping from a source address space to a destination address space at an address inside a virtual area. It signals a retry when the source is not huge, otherwise it ensures shared writable mappings become write protected and publishes an aged entry at the destination.

Offers lazy discard for a PMD sized huge range under advice driven freeing. It declines zero entries, unsuitable non present entries, shared mappings, and contended folios, asks for a split when only part of the huge extent is covered, otherwise invalidates tracked access and dirtiness and marks the folio for deferred freeing.
Huge PUD duplication holds both destination and source table locks together, with nesting on the second acquisition, and releases both on success and on early retry.

Supports relocation of an established huge PMD within one address space. It requires an empty destination, carries soft dirtiness across present and swap forms, normalizes userfault markers based on area registration, and moves a preallocated table only when anonymous mappings use distinct table locks.

Huge PMD relocation depends on exclusive address space ownership to order the two table locks safely, nesting only when they differ, and flushes the old extent when the relocated entry had been present.

Provides collective protection and hint updates for huge PMD and PUD entries. Present entries are invalidated in place without transient clearing before installing revised protections with userfault and writability handling, while non present migration or device entries are reduced to readable form with relevant markers retained.

Hint eligibility blends locality, policy, and folio state. Mappings already local for single threaded private owners and top tier nodes when normal balancing is off are skipped, as are device backed, merged, pinned, dirty file backed, and shared write on copy cases, with timing refreshed for folios that use access time.
Huge PUD updates stay outside NUMA balancing and outside userfault write and read write tracking, reporting no progress when such requests arrive, while huge PMD updates implement those behaviors.

Implements cross area relocation of a huge PMD for page migration. It checks alignment and destination emptiness, waits then retries on migration entries, accepts only exclusive anonymous heads that remain unpinned, handles zero and anonymous sources through different construction, refreshes reverse mapping and index, and re arms tracking when the destination needs it.

Cross area relocation starts with the source table lock and both area locks held, releases the source lock while preparing caches, notifiers, and folio state, then reacquires both table locks together for final validation before publishing, with a paired release afterwards.
Paired table locking orders the two locks by address, nests the second only when distinct, and balances identical lock handling with matching annotations on acquisition and release.

Keeps huge PMD mappings aligned with area boundaries during resizing. Unaligned edges that intersect a huge aligned span trigger a split at that edge, applied to the start, the end, and a following area whose start moves.

Checks whether a large folio may be divided toward a target order. Writeback and truncated unmapped non anonymous cases report contention, while zero folios, anonymous order one targets, and mismatched swap cached targets report invalid use.

Supplies reclamation helpers for large folios. Locked anonymous discard checks cleanliness or droppability plus reference stability before removing mapping and adjusting counts, file ranges use plain unmapping while anonymous ranges use migration preservation, and migration entries are later restored across the affected extent.

Large folio reclamation walks reverse mappings with external locking already held in synchronous batched mode, adds huge split handling when PMD mappable, and picks a poison aware walker for hugetlb versus the standard walker otherwise.

Hint driven protection changes under shared address space membership must not clear entries transiently, because a concurrent unmapping scan could miss the entry and leave a re established mapping behind. In place invalidation preserves access and dirty observations.

Anonymous huge discard orders table clearing before reference sampling and reference sampling before dirtiness sampling, restoring the original entry whenever dirtiness returns or references exceed the expected isolated plus mapped total, to stay safe against concurrent fast lookups.

Cross area moves validate both endpoints again after reacquiring locks and recheck pinning and exclusivity, putting the source entry back when a pin lands after clearing, so pinned or concurrently altered pages fail instead of migrating.
Relocation must abort when the destination becomes populated through a race with collapsing of shared or file backed pages, and such an unexpected destination must never already hold a huge entry.

Lazy freeing moves among declined, split for partial coverage, and completed outcomes. Completion pairs an invalidated entry with cleared access and dirty tracking plus deferred freeing, while shared or contended inputs leave state unchanged.

Protection updates move present huge entries through invalidate then install with conditional flushing, and move non present entries through readable reduction with marker retention, exiting early when already hinted or protected or when the folio is ineligible.

Huge relocation moves from validation through source clearing to publication with table transfer and conditional flushing. A zero source path normalizes markers instead of rebuilding protections from folio state, and tracking may be re armed at the destination.

Observed links connect a virtual area to its address space, flag set, and page protections, connect gathering and protection work to the owning address space and huge granularity, and connect a folio to mapping and index state used during reverse mapping maintenance.

Unmapping traversal is set up with a per mapping handler chosen by folio kind, a completion check based on mapped status, an anonymous locking helper, and caller flags carried as control data, run under either externally held or internally acquired walking.
Huge granularity is conveyed with PMD and PUD sized extents and corresponding base page counts, used for range sizing, alignment checks, translation maintenance scope, and usage accounting.

Collective protection work reaches huge PMD and PUD handlers, table relocation reaches the huge move helper, address space duplication reaches the huge PUD copier, advice freeing reaches the huge PMD handler, and area resizing reaches the huge aware adjust helper.
Single threaded private status holds only for non shared mappings whose owning address space has exactly one user.
Two variants of NUMA eligibility exist, one that always declines and one that applies detailed folio and policy checks, indicating a fallback or configuration gated implementation.
